name: sudoku-core
description: Pure, dependency-free sudoku generation, solving and difficulty rating (decision 3).

scripts.mine-examples: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/training/mine.js > dist/examples.raw.json && prettier --stdin-filepath src/training/examples.json < dist/examples.raw.json > dist/examples.json && mv dist/examples.json src/training/examples.json
